items.title: Security Council LIVE: Can conflict resolution keep pace as AI and drones reshape war?

The Security Council on Tuesday is weighing these changes, with UN chief António Guterres telling ambassadors, “killer robots must have no place in our future.”

items.title: Housing crisis on the ballot: Anger boils over ahead of Spanish election

In calling the snap election, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez is hoping the housing issue can galvanise his left-wing base.
